🔥 Habo | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: Tracking personal habits with a strong emphasis on user privacy and data control, including options for secure cloud sync or self-hosting.
✨ Key Features: • End-to-end encrypted sync (E2EE) • Zero-knowledge architecture • Automatic encrypted backups • Self-hostable backend support • Multiple completion types (yes/no, numeric, skip)
📖 Summary: Habo is a privacy-focused, open-source habit tracker for iOS and Android. It offers end-to-end encrypted synchronization, automatic encrypted backups, and self-hosting capabilities, ensuring users maintain full control over their data.
